column5: `scripts/plan39/two-plus-share-backtest.mjs` is a separate research-only comparison of the proposed annual education-share formula against the 2017-share anchor baseline. It reads exact raw values from the retained official 2025-base CTI XLSX files and the official annual January `setai-n` files for 2017–2025. The January source URL, SHA-256, sheet, reported year, national column, denominator, exact 1/2/3/4/5+ counts and shares, and row/cell extraction evidence are recorded in `two-plus-share-backtest/source-trace.json`; the extracted national shares are also written to `two-plus-share-backtest/lfs-national-shares.csv`. column5: The calibration is only 2017: `K=(pAedu_2017/pBedu_2017)/pi2plus_2017`, where `pAedu=A_education/A_total`, `pBedu=B_education/B_total`, and `pi2plus=1-pi_1`. The candidate is `pHat_Aedu_t=pBedu_t*pi2plus_t*K`; the comparison baseline is `pHat_Aedu_t=pBedu_t*(pAedu_2017/pBedu_2017)`. 2017 is excluded from validation. Per-year predictions/residuals and 2018–2025 coverage, MAE, RMSE, and bias are in `results/plan39/two-plus-share-backtest/annual-backtest.csv` and `summary.json`. Across 8/8 validation years, the anchor baseline has MAE `0.06714`, RMSE `0.08422`, and bias `+0.06169` percentage points; the `pi2plus` model has MAE `0.11490`, RMSE `0.14372`, and bias `−0.09042` percentage points. Thus adding `pi2plus` worsens both absolute-error metrics in this backtest. The 2017–2025 source trace includes unrounded raw CTI totals/education values and their XLSX cell locations. If a validation year fails its source checks, that year is omitted and coverage/failure details are recorded; a missing or invalid 2017 calibration input stops the backtest without a new result.

column5: `scripts/plan39/anchor-only-category-backtest.mjs` uses exact numeric cells from the retained 2025-base CTI basic B and adjusted A workbooks (`総・年`) for all ten expenditure classifications. Exact Japanese header matches map the nine published lower categories; `Other` uses its numeric workbook value in 2020–2025 and is derived as total minus those nine categories in 2017–2019, where the workbook cell is `-`. The source status and cell coordinates are captured by workbook/year. Direct Other values differ from the residual by at most 0.0004 index points in B (2020) and 0.0003 in A (2021), so the 2020 switch from residual to official Other is a category-specific comparability caveat.

column5: The per-category anchor is `q[c]=pA[2017,c]/pB[2017,c]`; the requested raw prediction is `pHatRaw[t,c]=pB[t,c]*q[c]`. The separately labeled coherent variant divides each raw prediction by that year's sum across categories. Both are validated on 2018–2025 only (8 years); category errors and MAE/RMSE/bias are reported in percentage points. `results/plan39/anchor-only-category-backtest/summary.json` records formulas, metrics, annual values, source hashes and exact cells; `annual-category-backtest.csv` contains the 80 validation category-year rows and each year's raw predicted category-share sum. Recreate with `node scripts/plan39/anchor-only-category-backtest.mjs`. This is research-only and is not consumed by production estimators, loaders, gates, or quarterly data.
